period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (as published in UCB's own annual report's 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financial Statements by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table -- a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure, not a discrete-quarter figure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK. Re-sourced via fresh PDF download and dual independent re-extraction (see source.source_document) because the archived .txt's rendering of this table is corrupted. This table's own printed column headers for the 1st-quarter pair are themselves mislabeled in the source PDF (both columns carry garbled/duplicated period labels -- one reads '1 Jan 2014 to 30 Jun 2014 / 2nd qtr-14', the other '1 Jan 2015 to 31 Mar 2015 / 1st qtr' -- an apparent copy-paste error in UCB's own report design, confirmed present in both the direct visual read and the independent tesseract pass, so it is a genuine source-document defect, not a transcription error here). The DATA under these two columns is nonetheless unambiguous once cross-checked: this quarter's total assets of 269,828.03 sits between FY2014's already-recorded year-end total assets (266,100.74) and this same table's own H1-2015 figure (279,656.13), a smooth progression; the other (comparative) column's total assets of 223,582.33 matches the FY2014 annual report's own directly-reported 'Q1-2014' column (223,582.33) exactly. Every other row in the pair (equity, loans, deposits, investments, income-statement items) confirms the same column assignment the same way. eps_cumulative (0.80) and nav_per_share (22.33) both reproduce exactly from this quarter's own net_profit_after_tax_cumulative/equity divided by 1,003.934m shares outstanding (paid-up capital 10,039.34m / BDT10 par) -- the higher share count reflects a 20% stock dividend (paid-up capital rose from 8,366.12m at FY2014-end to 10,039.34m, already fully reflected by Q1-2015), which mechanically explains why NAV/share (22.33) is lower than FY2014's 26.88 despite equity being similar -- not a data error.

source.source_document: Annual-report-2015-part1.pdf, PDF page 96 (printed page 92) -- re-downloaded directly from ucb.com.bd for this extraction because the archived ucb-annual-report-2015.txt's pdftotext rendering of this specific table has corrupted number formatting (missing thousand-separators/decimal points and, in the table-of-contents bullet just above it, OCR-garbled text: "oO ©) Audit Committee & by the Board"). The whole PDF proved to be a 146dpi image scan with zero embedded text layer (pdffonts returns no fonts at all) -- the existing .txt was therefore itself produced by an earlier OCR pass, not native pdftotext, which explains the corruption. The target page was re-rendered at 400dpi (pdftoppm) and read directly (visual transcription), then independently cross-checked with a full-page tesseract 5.5.3 OCR pass at the same resolution; the two methods agreed on every one of the table's 68 data cells (tesseract merely drops some thousand-separators/decimal points and one or two minus signs, but never a digit). The PDF was deleted immediately after extraction per project policy -- only this .json and the citation here are retained.
